title: The Financial Times names Incorruptible a best business book of 2026
summary: The Financial Times names Incorruptible one of the best business books of 2026 in its year-end selection.
attribution_title: Best books of 2026 — Business, the paper's year-end selection
blockquote: Intrigued by the failure of some principled entrepreneurs to realise their goals, Ries looks into the forces that stand in their way. The author of The Lean Startup takes issue with “best practices”, such as quarterly reporting, that hold back visionary business leaders.

source_urls.label: Matt James, Senior Commissioning Editor at Penguin Life, on the listing
